title: Uniform-in-Time Boltzmann Mean-Field Limits for Anchored Binary Opinion Dynamics
summary: We study a continuous-time opinion model in which agents interact in pairs and each agent has a fixed anchor. At each interaction, both opinions are updated according to a possibly nonlinear rule with random inputs. Under suitable stability and moment assumptions, we establish uniform-in-time propagation of chaos: as the population grows, any fixed number of agents become asymptotically independent, with a common law solving a nonlinear Boltzmann equation.
